tagline: Sync Airtable records with Todoist tasks for structured project tracking
metaTitle: Airtable Todoist Integration: Records to Tasks and Back
metaDescription: Create Todoist tasks from Airtable records assigned to you and sync completions back to Airtable. GAIA tracks milestones too. See the setup steps.
intro:
Airtable is the flexible database that teams use to track projects, content calendars, client lists, and operational workflows. Todoist is where individuals plan and execute their daily work. When a row in a base represents work that someone needs to do, there is an inevitable gap: the record captures the data but the individual's task list is where the actual planning happens. Without a bridge, records and tasks diverge and accountability suffers.

GAIA connects the two so database records and personal tasks stay synchronized. When a record is assigned to you or its status changes to In Progress, GAIA creates the corresponding Todoist task so your personal planner reflects your assigned database work. When you complete the task, GAIA updates the record status so the shared database reflects real-world progress.

This integration is ideal for content teams using Airtable as an editorial calendar and a task manager for individual writing tasks, for operations teams where rows represent deliverables assigned to team members, and for project managers who want a single personal task view that includes both personal tasks and database-tracked responsibilities.

useCases.title: Create Todoist tasks from assigned Airtable records
useCases.description: When a record is assigned to you or a status field changes to a trigger value, GAIA creates a task with the record name, due date, and a link back to the row.

useCases.title: Sync task completion back to Airtable
useCases.description: When you mark a linked task complete, GAIA updates the corresponding record status to Done so the shared database reflects actual work completion in real time.

useCases.title: Editorial calendar task generation
useCases.description: For content teams with a publishing calendar in a base, GAIA creates writing and editing tasks from calendar rows as their scheduled dates approach, complete with deadlines and brief links.

useCases.title: Project database milestone tracking
useCases.description: When a project record reaches its planned milestone date without a completion status, GAIA creates an overdue alert task and flags the record in the base.

useCases.title: New record assignment notifications
useCases.description: When a new row is added to a base and assigned to a team member, GAIA creates a task for that person immediately so new work is captured before it is forgotten.

howItWorks.step: Connect Todoist and Airtable to GAIA
howItWorks.description: Authenticate your task account and connect your Airtable workspace to GAIA. Select the specific bases and views that GAIA should monitor for trigger conditions.

howItWorks.step: Map record fields to task properties
howItWorks.description: Tell GAIA which field maps to the task title, which date field becomes the due date, and which status values trigger task creation or completion.

howItWorks.step: GAIA keeps records and tasks synchronized
howItWorks.description: GAIA monitors your base for qualifying record changes and your task list for completions, propagating updates between the base and the task list automatically.

faqs.question: Can GAIA work with multiple Airtable bases simultaneously?
faqs.answer: Yes. You can connect multiple bases and map each to a different project so work from different databases lands in the right task list.

faqs.question: Will GAIA sync all records or only those assigned to me?
faqs.answer: By default GAIA only creates tasks for records assigned to your account. You can optionally configure it to watch an entire view regardless of assignee.

faqs.question: Does GAIA support linked record fields?
faqs.answer: GAIA can read values from linked record fields and include them in the task description, but it does not currently create tasks from linked records automatically.

faqs.question: What happens to the Todoist task if a record is deleted?
faqs.answer: GAIA detects the deletion and marks the linked task as cancelled so your active task list stays clean.
